description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pilapitiya, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320555
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, cadastral map references, and ownership details) by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses entirely on land registration, title settlement, and property ownership determinations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land-related administrative matters present.
